Find the Magnetic Lock on the Crate and manually disable it

notThisCargo.note: the 'Precious Cargo' interact quests belong to another quest (a magnetically locked crate on another map), not to BP_PreciousCargo, which uses DA_InteractionQuest_Frigate_SpecialCargo_Loot

latchInteraction.inferred: two coordinated 'Breach' interactions (A and B) per latch: read as two Raiders breaching together (the coordinator's purpose); the latch's class default is truncated

stringPrompt.inferred: a 'Drop Cargo' prompt exists in the string tables; no decoded export names it

descent.packageImportsNote: assets BP_PreciousCargo's package imports, read from the raw header: its class default object is truncated, so which property uses each is not known

profile.note: the 2.00 usmap does not know FrigateCargoDescentProfile: the numbers are read raw, their property names and meaning are unknown

lethal.inferred: the package imports the lethal crush effect: read as the landing cargo killing whoever is under it (by the asset name)

dropsites.note: markers only (a FrigateCargoDropsiteComponent 'AccessVisualization' and a mesh; the Angelscript class FrigateCargoDropsite is not in the paks): which site a cargo uses is decided at run time (inferred: nothing in the files links the ship's cargo to one site)

where.note: every Hydra slot of the ship (enemies.json): the remains lie where a Hydra is destroyed

table.note: what a breach generates with the skill (docs/containers-data.md 'A breach is the prop's material bonus'), not the container's loot

others.note: every one belongs to a lamp (BP_ARC_*Lamp*): a shootable lamp's health, with no item, loot tag or table in its Blueprint
